WITH base AS (
    SELECT p.category, i.qty, i.unit_price
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'order_items') }} i
    JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'products') }} p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(category) AS category,
        SUM(CAST(ROUND(qty * unit_price * 100) AS HUGEINT)) AS total_cents,
        COUNT(qty * unit_price) AS n_nonnull,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY LOWER(RTRIM(category))
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        CASE
            WHEN n_nonnull > 0
            THEN (total_cents * 10000) // n_nonnull
            ELSE NULL
        END AS avg_micro,
        line_count
    FROM agg
)
SELECT
    category,
    CAST(CAST(avg_micro AS DECIMAL(38,6)) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS avg_line_value,
    line_count
FROM calc

explanation: This procedure rebuilds a summary table that shows, for each product category, the average line value (quantity times unit price) across all order line items and the total number of line items. It only counts items that match a known product. The model below also matches SQL Server's case-insensitive grouping, so categories that differ only in letter case or trailing spaces are merged into one row.
